title.narrative: The Lao PDR Government strengthened the WASH enabling environment with UNICEF’s support, achieving 17 Open Defecation Free provinces, and developing strategies for equitable and climate resilient water and sanitation by 2030. Contributing efforts included gender assessments, menstrual hygiene support, affordability studies, climate resilience initiatives and partnerships, fostering inclusive, sustainable WASH progress through advocacy, evidence, and sector collaboration.
